newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 364-day T-bill yields average 18.68 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 364-day T-bill yields average 18.68 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of Russian 364-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 18.68 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
Dealers had forecast the average yield between 18.32 and 18.93 percent.
Series 21082 bills maturing on July 29, 1998, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed at 84.45 on Tuesday, to yield 18.77 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:
On August 6, the Finance Ministry will offer 10.00 trillion roubles of 728-day OFZ interest-bearing bonds (series 24017).

It will also repay about 6.81 trillion roubles ($1.2 billion) in a maturing 168-day T-bill (series 22073) and pay about 412.6 billion roubles in interest on series 24006 OFZ interest-bearing bonds. It has already repaid 5.33 trillion roubles of the bond early on a voluntary basis.
